distribution: Longsheng, Guangxi; Jiulianshan and Jingdezhen, Jiangxi; Wuyishan, Fujian.
soldier: Head pale brown to deep brown, the nasus deeper than the head, antennae, anterior half of the pronotum and abdominal tergites brown, legs pale white. The tip of the nasus with several hairs, the head and thorax almost hairless, the abdominal tergites with only a few fine short hairs. Without the nasus the head is slightly broader than long; in front view it is constricted at the base of the nasus and at the antennal sockets, slightly convex between the two constrictions, gourd-shaped; strongly convex behind the antennal sockets, the sides circular, the posterior margin slightly flat. Nasus slender and tubular, the fontanelle at its tip appearing as a transparent point, in profile the tip of the nasus and the back of the head at about the same level, slightly concave between them. Mandibles bluntly convex, without a spine. Antennae with 14 segments, the third longer than the second, the second almost equal to the fourth. The anterior half of the pronotum upright and upturned, meeting the posterior half at a right angle, the median notch of the anterior margin distinct, that of the posterior margin indistinct. Spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with four segments. The species is dimorphic in size, the small soldier resembling the large soldier in colour and in hairlessness, its head and nasus paler, antennae with 13 segments, the third twice as long as the second.
